name: Micro Center in-store refurbished GeForce RTX 3090 / 3090 Ti 24GB tier
vendor: Micro Center (refurb programme) / NVIDIA / AIB partners
price_basis: REFURBISHED (product titles carry an explicit '(Refurbished)' suffix), bare PCIe consumer card, $1,099.99 flat for EVERY RTX 3090 24GB model regardless of AIB - EVGA FTW3 Ultra, ASUS TUF and ROG Strix, MSI Suprim X / Gaming X Trio / Ventus 3x, Gigabyte Gaming OC / Eagle / Turbo / Vision, PNY XLR8, Zotac Gaming Trinity, and NVIDIA Founders Edition all at $1,099.99. RTX 3090 Ti 24GB (EVGA FTW3 Ultra and FTW3 Black, ASUS TUF, MSI Suprim X) flat at $1,239.99. Captured 2026-10-03. Refurb warranty present but term not published in the extracted page.
notes: Two decision-relevant facts. (1) The perfectly FLAT per-tier pricing - one price for every AIB, no board-specific spread - is a deliberate channel-design choice and makes this the single most price-transparent refurb channel observed: you know exactly what you pay before you walk in, and there is no haggling and no per-board lottery. (2) Every row carries 'BUY IN STORE', so this is store-inventory only - it will not ship, and stock varies by store. That caps it as a channel: useful for filling a couple of slots quickly, useless as a supply line. VALUE CONTEXT: at $1,099.99 a refurbished 3090 24GB is a well-specified 24GB GDDR6X card for under half the new 4090 price and roughly half the used-4090 price - which makes it the most cost-effective 24GB-per-dollar option in this entire slice, and the obvious inference build card. Same channel also carries refurbished RTX 5090 Founders Edition 32GB and a large refurbished GTX 1080 back-catalogue.
